session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious, like I'm stuck between wanting to move forward and being scared of failing again. It's hard to know if I should keep going or just stop.
That sounds really heavy. Can you tell me why you feel like you're stuck?
I keep thinking about all the projects I started before and how I ended up abandoning them. I worry that if I try again, I'll fail and prove to myself that I'm not good enough.
It makes sense that this would feel overwhelming. Can you explain why you think you're not good enough?

I keep comparing myself to the past, when I had more confidence and didn't second-guess everything. Now, every challenge feels like a sign that I'm not capable, and I don't know how to believe in myself anymore.
That sounds like a tough cycle to be in. Can you tell me why you feel like you're not capable anymore?
I used to feel like I could handle anything, but now every setback feels like proof that I'm not strong enough. I keep thinking, what if I fail again? What if no one ever really sees my work?
It's clear how much this is weighing on you. Can you tell me why you think no one will ever see your work?

I used to think people would care about what I did, but now I feel like I'm just trying to prove something to myself. If I don't get validation from others, it feels like my work doesn't matter at all.
That sounds like a deep sense of doubt. Can you tell me why you feel like your work only matters if others see it?

Because I used to believe that if I didn't succeed or if people didn't acknowledge my efforts, it meant I wasn't worth anything. I keep looking for proof that I matter, but I can't seem to find it on my own.
It seems like you're carrying a lot of internal pressure. Can you tell me why you feel like you need proof to know you matter?
I used to think that if I didn't have others' approval, I wasn't enough. I keep trying to find validation because it's the only way I know how to feel like I'm not a waste.
That sounds like a painful pattern to live with. Can you tell me why you feel like you're a waste if you don't get validation?
Because I used to believe that my worth was tied to what others thought of me. If I didn't succeed or if people didn't notice my work, it felt like I was failing and that I didn't deserve to be here.
It sounds like your self-worth has been deeply connected to external validation. Can you tell me why you feel like you don't deserve to be here?
I used to think that if I wasn't successful or if people didn't care about what I did, it meant I wasn't valuable. I kept feeling like I was a burden, like I didn't belong or matter.
That must have been incredibly painful. Can you tell me why you feel like you don't belong?

I used to think that if I wasn't recognized or appreciated, it meant I wasn't good enough to be part of anything. I kept feeling like I was always on the outside, waiting for someone to finally see me.
